title: scientific-evidence-gate citation documents
description: The three documents the citation checks read (ARCHITECTURE.md section 9): the citations as written (manifest citations.entries), an external verifier's log (citations.log) and a frozen capture of resolver answers (citations.frozen). This schema is documentation: validation is implemented in science_gate/citations.py and science_gate/adapters/, which also refuse malformed JSON (duplicate keys, NaN, Infinity), duplicate citation ids, duplicate invocation ids and two frozen records for one DOI. A structural violation makes the reading check ABSTAIN with PROTOCOL_BROKEN. Missing evidence fields are not structural: an incomplete invocation backs no claim, and a frozen record with missing provenance makes its DOI SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.

utc_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC with a Z suffix, as science_gate._clock.parse_utc accepts.

doi.description: A DOI, optionally prefixed by doi: or a doi.org resolver URL. Prefixes are removed and ASCII letters folded before any comparison.

given.description: Omitted or null: given names are not compared for this author.

label.description: A volume or issue. A non-negative integer is read as its decimal text.

work.description: The minimum metadata kept about a work. The DOI, title and author set identify it; year, journal, volume and issue are compared only when both sides give them.

citation.description: One citation as written in the manuscript: a work plus its identifier.

entries_document.title: citations.entries
entries_document.description: Citation ids are unique. An empty list makes the resolver and metadata checks NOT_APPLICABLE, never PASS.

invocation.description: One recorded verification attempt. invocation_id and citation_id identify it (structural). request, response_sha256 and retrieved_at are its evidence: if any is missing or malformed, the invocation is listed as incomplete and backs no claim.

verification_log.title: citations.log
verification_log.description: The contract's log format. A citation claimed VERIFIED with no complete invocation is UNVERIFIED with NARRATED_VERIFICATION, and claimed_verified is set against the complete invocations by the checked_claims_le_invocations invariant. A missing or null invocations list means no invocation was recorded at all; it is reported as unknown, never as zero.

frozen_record.description: One captured resolver answer, keyed by the requested DOI. The six provenance fields are not required by structure, but a record missing or mangling any of them makes its DOI SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE. FOUND needs a work (and a 2xx status if one is given); NOT_FOUND and ERROR carry none. NOT_FOUND yields DOI_NOT_RESOLVED_AT_CAPTURE; a DOI with no record at all is SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.
